rows.requirement: Both orientations of chunk-median grouping

rows.requirement: Chunk group multiset and cardinality decomposition
rows.assessment: Multiplicity is preserved through grouping and the summed input counts.

rows.assessment: Both sides ≤ceil(7n/10+3), including ties and short final chunk; empty counts are handled explicitly.

rows.requirement: Insertion-based slow selection and median values
rows.assessment: Actual insertion execution is used; sorting value uniqueness does not substitute another sorter cost.

rows.requirement: Actual nested size-five/cutoff-twenty selection

rows.requirement: Correctness of the actual nested computation
rows.assessment: Total dependent well-founded construction combines source partial correctness and termination. The proof-plan combined affine/rank/map consumer is absent from this snapshot; see the separate focused-passed composition follow-on.

rows.requirement: Noncircular nested termination and total failure domain
rows.assessment: Private worker carries input membership before correctness/cost proofs; first child decreases for d≥2 and cutoff≥1, later children by pivot membership. Invalid entry guard returns none with n+2 cost.

rows.requirement: Actual one-pass partition and n+1 calls
rows.assessment: Accepted measured prerequisite; the recurrence is one pass rather than three independent filters.

rows.requirement: Slow selection exact cost and valid-index bound
rows.assessment: Actual insertion plus lookup; for k<n the bound is n²+3n+1.

rows.requirement: Slow median exact cost and small-chunk bound
rows.assessment: Charges its length observation; nonempty bound n²+4n+2, hence 47 for size≤5.

rows.requirement: Measured chopping with both source traversals
rows.assessment: Positive-d exact cost 2n+3ceil(n/d)+1; all-d bound 5n+1. Take and drop are separately charged.

rows.requirement: Actual median-map callback sum and preparation bounds
rows.assessment: Map cost is sum of actual callbacks plus m+1; ≤48m+1≤10n+48, and complete preparation≤15n+49.

rows.requirement: Exact branch-sensitive nested source equations
rows.assessment: Entry length is cached; left branch omits equal-length traversal and equal branch omits a second recursive call. Actual counts 83/273, 269/231/266 and 239 are distinct from scalar budgets.

rows.requirement: Exact monotone scalar F
rows.assessment: Base 483, cutoff20, toll19n+54; children ceil(n/5), ceil(7n/10+3), with strict descent and monotonicity proved before resizing.

rows.requirement: Actual book execution bounded by F
rows.assessment: Actual recurrence induction combines measured auxiliaries, valid child ranks and F monotonicity; all-rank extension also handles the explicit invalid guard.

rows.requirement: Exact rounded real recurrence
rows.assessment: The two contraction coefficients are a and c; signed offsets b,d and signed C2 are retained.

rows.requirement: Ceiling descent with zero truncation
rows.assessment: Thresholds use max(0,b), max(0,d); zero-truncated natural ceiling is not replaced with untruncated real arithmetic.

rows.requirement: Nonstrict slope suffices; strict-choice error
rows.assessment: C3≥C1/(1−a−c) is sufficient; the source maximum may attain equality.

rows.requirement: Explicit constants and full strong induction
rows.assessment: Finite-prefix maximum, positive denominator, nonnegative slope and all natural inputs are connected in the proof.

rows.requirement: General real-valued affine existence
rows.assessment: No f≥0 or C2≥0 hypothesis; only the sufficient theorem is claimed, not an unsupported converse.

rows.requirement: Natural-valued corollary from the real theorem
rows.assessment: Casts and nonnegative ceilings produce natural constants without duplicating the real induction.

rows.requirement: Exact F specialization and affine growth
Uniform actual book source cost
rows.assessment: Constants precede payload type/order, input and rank; positivity is required only for intercept absorption. C03-083 separately compares actual input acquisition with coordinate-query competitors.

rows.requirement: Actual one-pass minimum and its paid execution
rows.assessment: Tail-recursive minimum has exact n+1 calls. Its value equality with general fixed-rank selection is not used to pretend equal costs.

rows.requirement: Actual one-pass second minimum with duplicates
rows.assessment: Correctness is derived after the actual loop correspondence to fixed rank one; the second occurrence may equal the minimum.

rows.requirement: Actual bounded-prefix streaming fixed-rank selection
rows.assessment: One traversal of the input, with bounded sorted accumulator width k+1 and per-step source cost linear in that width.

rows.requirement: Second-minimum loop equals fixed rank one
rows.assessment: An actual algorithm/loop equality, not only common extensional correctness.

rows.requirement: Uniform fixed-rank source cost including k=0
rows.assessment: Explicit 2kn+6n+k+4 witnesses precede all inputs/ranks; the n-term remains at k=0.

rows.requirement: Every coordinate can affect every valid rank
rows.assessment: Int, distinct original input, valid k and i; a fresh replacement is derived and preserves distinctness, not assumed. Query lower bound is separate.

rows.requirement: Actual extrema-padding rank-to-median reduction
rows.assessment: No global extrema assumptions: actual input min/max. Valid output is odd, nonempty, length≤2n−1; duplicates and even original lengths are covered.

rows.requirement: Paid reduction including extrema and all construction
rows.assessment: Charges both extrema scans, length, replicas and append: exact 4n+2A+B+8; valid-rank bound 6n+6. Invalid-rank countercase protects the domain.

rows.requirement: Least actual cutoff versus scalar cutoff
rows.assessment: Actual minimum cutoff1 for d≥2; scalar minimum13; cutoff20 accommodates scalar descent and 483 base. The analytical self-call relation is connected to actual guarded preparation, including invalid guard. No unique author motive is asserted.

rows.requirement: Universal growing family exceeding seventy percent
rows.assessment: All i: n=10i+6>0, actual pivot0, Ngt=7i+5, so 10Ngt=7n+8. This is an infinite strict family, not finite experimentation.

rows.requirement: General-group two-sided pivot bound
rows.assessment: For every d>0, q=floor(d/2), m=ceil(n/d), bound q*m+(d−q)*floor(m/2), including duplicates and short final chunk; connects to actual partition sizes.

rows.requirement: General groups: correctness, termination and sufficient linear costs
rows.assessment: d≥2/cutoff≥1 actual correctness and termination; d=1 actual self-call obstruction. Fraction contracts iff d−floor(d/2)>2 (odd≥5/even≥6); d=3,4 gives1. Actual sufficient-group cost uses a uniform finite prefix covering both cutoffs, with constants before payloads/ranks. Fixed Mom core built, but its two private example proof tails still fail lints; focused-passed successor is a separate follow-on.

rows.requirement: Actual fresh uniform-occurrence random recursion
rows.assessment: Each nonempty state uses a new finite uniform occurrence choice in PMF bind and follows only the rank-selected child. This is not one fixed deterministic policy.

rows.requirement: Duplicate-aware uniform value pushforward
rows.assessment: [0,0,1] has value masses 2/3 and1/3; uniform distinct-value choice is not substituted.

rows.requirement: Random termination, child validity and correct result
rows.assessment: Actual supported outcomes terminate within n active calls. Valid-rank correctness and public one-based bridge preserve explicit failure behavior.

rows.requirement: Actual trace scan-volume observation
rows.assessment: Each active positive length is observed; only the reached child is added, with absorbed zero after termination.

rows.requirement: Every path has triangular scan upper bound
rows.assessment: Uniform bound n(n+1)/2 holds with duplicates and all ranks; it is separate from attainment.

rows.requirement: Universal bad-endpoint path and exact factorial mass
rows.assessment: GAP at fixed random snapshot: only a supported n=2 triangular path is present. Need every distinct input and every valid target rank, a specified endpoint sequence retaining the target to singleton, exact probability1/n!, triangular attainment and an unbounded Nat/Int family.

rows.requirement: Correct worst-case quantifiers and all-equal stopping
rows.assessment: Deterministic minimum-rank0 counterexample is connected and checked. Fixed random snapshot has singleton/two-equal cases only; the general positive-length all-equal actual PMF law is absent.

rows.requirement: Stable occurrence-rank coupling and actual child dominance
rows.assessment: No global Nodup assumption. A stable rank distinguishes tied occurrences and the actual selected strict side is bounded by max(r,m−1−r).

rows.requirement: Exact three-quarter conditional drift
rows.assessment: Finite rank sum and actual next-size expectation; singleton/parity are retained, without asserting independence between later sizes.

rows.requirement: Uniform expected scan work
rows.assessment: n≤E W≤4n for fixed input/rank; real and nonnegative-integral forms are connected and finite. Constants are independent of an input distribution.

rows.requirement: Absorbing active sizes and geometric expectation
rows.assessment: E X_j≤(3/4)^j n for all natural j, using the actual dependent recursion and zero after termination.

rows.requirement: Expected residual scan work
rows.assessment: E residual after w steps≤4(3/4)^w n; actual state/trace conditioning is preserved.

rows.requirement: Exact non-strict scan tail with positive input size
rows.assessment: For natural w and n>0, Pr[W≥(4+w)n]≤(3/4)^w. This is an original elementary proof of the displayed law, not verification of the inaccessible Karp paper.

rows.requirement: Actual prefix/residual decomposition and Markov premises
rows.assessment: First w scans≤wn; the tail event forces residual≥4n; nonnegativity and integrability belong to the actual residual law.

rows.requirement: Larger-side recurrence is only a majorant
rows.assessment: Concrete n=5,k=0,pivot rank1 has actual next size1 versus upper majorant3; no equality is substituted.

rows.requirement: Pathwise source-cost/scan bridge
rows.assessment: W≤T≤9W+2 charges pivot retrieval, partition, length observations and reached branch work. Uniform sampling is abstract; no random-bit or physical-runtime claim.

rows.requirement: Actual expected/tail bounds and worst-case transfer
rows.assessment: Expected n≤E T≤36n+2, tail threshold9(4+w)n+2 and quadratic upper are present. General quadratic lower/attainment transfer still requires the missing universal C03-064 witness.

rows.requirement: Tail quantifiers and interpretation
rows.assessment: Statement analysis: exponential decay is in the excess multiple w. Fixed w gives a fixed probability bound, not an automatic fixed-constant high-probability O(n) theorem as n grows. Optional logarithmic excess is not required.

rows.requirement: Connected random examples and positive finite worst path
rows.assessment: Finite cases include valid rank0, endpoint-rank cases on two occurrences, multiple supported traces with the same result and an actual positive-probability triangular path. These do not discharge the universal C03-064 theorem.

rows.requirement: Actual paid minimum-pivot path and corrected rank dependence
rows.assessment: Distinct valid input: k+1 active calls, k edges, W=(k+1)n−k(k+1)/2 and T=3W+7(k+1)+1. Actual pivot construction is paid. Largest rank is quadratic; each fixed rank is linear; duplicate countercase prevents overgeneralization.

rows.requirement: Outside-range pivot self-state and fuel obstruction
rows.assessment: For nonempty valid ranks, all finite fuels fail while the reached strict child preserves the state; an equivalent iteration obstruction is established without pretending the invalid policy satisfies PivotValid.

rows.requirement: Actual paid halving policy, logarithmic edges and linear work
rows.assessment: Actual adequate-fuel execution yields Halves; n≤W≤2n and edges≤ceil(log2 n). Concrete median policy measures its index-length observation and actual selectRun; constants precede all payloads/inputs/ranks. Singleton is one entry/zero edges, pivot cost10 and execution19.

rows.requirement: Adaptive coordinate-query protocol and replay
rows.assessment: Protocol receives only prior index/value transcript, not an uncharged full input. Valid Fin indices and total/all-input correctness are explicit; repeated queries remain observable.

rows.requirement: Correct distinct-input runs query every coordinate
rows.assessment: All-input correctness plus replacement/replay gives the contradiction. Fresh replacement is actually proved, so no hidden restriction to replacement inputs that remain distinct.

rows.requirement: Charged-query lower bound and actual acquisition/optimality bridge
rows.assessment: At fixed query snapshot the complete new bridge is source-present but uncompiled at assignment. Actual readAll acquires n coordinates, then actual selectRun runs on acquired answers; tariff is c*n+source calls. Uniform constants precede c,n,k,input/competitor; c≥1 for comparison. Front-end bookkeeping is explicitly outside this declared tariff. No arbitrary machine/randomized/runtime lower bound is claimed.
